2607.22045.title: CEL: Comprehensive Counterfactual Explanations Library and Benchmark
2607.22045.paper_summary: Counterfactual explanations are a prominent approach in explainable artificial intelligence (xAI), providing actionable guidance on what input changes would alter a model's prediction to a desired outcome. While early methods primarily focused on minimal feature changes, recent work incorporates additional properties such as sparsity, actionability and plausibility. Despite this progress, fair and systematic evaluation remains challenging. Existing studies often rely on different data splits, predictive models, and evaluation metrics, which limits objective comparison across methods. To fill this gap, we introduce CEL (Counterfactual Explanations Library), a unified library and benchmark for counterfactual explanations designed to support consistent implementation and evaluation. CEL includes 18 datasets of varying size and complexity and provides implementations or reimplementations of 14 widely used counterfactual methods. Using this standardized setup, we conduct a comprehensive quantitative comparison across a variety of methods on datasets that differ in size, number, and types of attributes. The evaluation protocol incorporates multiple complementary metrics capturing validity, coverage, sparsity, proximity, and distributional plausibility, including density- and outlier-based measures to assess the realism of generated counterfactuals. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first comprehensive benchmark that systematically evaluates recent counterfactual explanation methods within a unified and reproducible framework. While prior libraries and benchmarking efforts exist in the literature, many are outdated, limited in scope, or lack consistent evaluation protocols. The proposed benchmark aims to improve reproducibility, enable fair comparison, and establish a workbench for the development of future counterfactual explanation methods.
2607.22045.paper_summary_zh: 反事實解釋是可解釋人工智慧（xAI）中的一個重要方法，提供可行的指導，說明哪些輸入變化會改變模型的預測以達到期望的結果。雖然早期的方法主要集中在最小特徵變化上，但最近的研究納入了額外的特性，如稀疏性、可行性和合理性。儘管取得了這些進展，公平和系統性的評估仍然具有挑戰性。現有的研究通常依賴不同的數據劃分、預測模型和評估指標，這限制了方法之間的客觀比較。為了填補這一空白，我們推出了CEL（反事實解釋庫），這是一個統一的庫和基準，旨在支持反事實解釋的一致實施和評估。CEL包括18個大小和複雜性各異的數據集，並提供14種廣泛使用的反事實方法的實現或重新實現。利用這一標準化設置，我們對多種方法在不同大小、數量和屬性類型的數據集上進行了全面的定量比較。評估協議納入了多個互補指標，以捕捉有效性、覆蓋率、稀疏性、接近性和分佈合理性，包括基於密度和異常值的度量，以評估生成的反事實的現實性。據我們所知，這是第一個在統一和可重複的框架內系統評估近期反事實解釋方法的全面基準。雖然文獻中存在先前的庫和基準工作，但許多都是過時的、範圍有限的，或缺乏一致的評估協議。所提出的基準旨在提高可重複性，促進公平比較，並為未來反事實解釋方法的開發建立一個工作平台。
